blind.description: A wall-mounted wooden shelf and peg rack with three hooded brown monastic robes hanging from the pegs. The upper rack features a carved wooden moulding shelf with decorative end brackets and round pegs. The robes feature sculpted fabric folds and hoods that hang naturally. The surfaces are solid, continuous, and clean, with warm wood tones on the rack and dark brown textured cloth on the garments.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden shelf with a stepped lip and profile moulding, showing the tops of three dark brown draped fabric folds protruding slightly from underneath.
blind.height_vs_figure: The rack floats at roughly 5 feet high; the model itself is around 3.5 feet tall and 3 feet wide.
